_about: Hand-kept facts the dashboard cannot read from files. Everything else on the page is computed. Edit, save, and the page shows it within a minute.

stages.name: Logging only
stages.note: Price test built; logger being tested

stages.name: Backtest proves the edge
stages.note: Needs paid data to fully pass; free version can only rule ideas out

stages.name: Paper trading (30–60 days)
stages.note: Paper ledger replays each logged day with cautious costs; no orders

decisions.title: Set the evidence target (days of logging)
decisions.why: 60 is a placeholder. More days means a surer verdict but a longer wait.

decisions.title: Account size vs. $5 width
decisions.why: Account cash is small: one $5-wide max loss is about $475, far above plan v2's 1–2% limit. Matters only before live trading.
